answer: One beacon per identity sits on a ridge above a lagoon, backed by 70 credits. Each epoch the beacon publishes the river flow; the identity files a key-signed reading within 5%, checked on the gauge table. Each miss burns 12% of the bond; three void it. First filing 42, the kth 42+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes burn 3,538,500 credits for a 40,000 pool. Rented beacons fail: readings carry the owner's ridge key. An honest agent pays 42 once, keeps its bond.
